tools.purpose: Inspect a local command's selection and admission without test execution or discovery.
tools.cost_hint: Parses command arguments only; no dependency scan or test subprocess.
tools.notes: TESTING.md owns risk-based selection recipes. This is not an exhaustive impact selector or named-test result proof. Use bin/oc-test broad for suites, shards and unknown command shapes.
Sanctioned local entry for the ten-process SQLite conformance harness.

tools.purpose: The local store test suite without the race detector, one CI shard per run.
tools.cost_hint: One CI shard under full admission; a shard is expected to finish well inside the 15-minute package alarm.
tools.notes: Run each shard index as its own invocation, store-shard 1 7 through store-shard 7 7, matching CI's current shard count; every run admits one shard and releases the shared slot between shards. The tier uses CI's scripts/go-test-shard.py selection with discovery inside admission. Required CI runs store tests in shards without race. Bounded verify-race remains a distinct CI-only selection, not this local invocation.

tools.purpose: Standard Go static analysis over every package.
Go source formatting check; empty output means formatted.
Go vulnerability scan against the pinned govulncheck version.
tools.notes: The version pin is load-bearing; CI rejects an unpinned run.

tools.purpose: File-selected Lefthook pre-push gates; the installed hook runs them on every push.
tools.cost_hint: Cheaper than the smoke tier; gates whose globs match no pushed file are skipped.
tools.notes: Every push uses the installed shared hook; CONTRIBUTING.md owns clone setup and failure recovery. Each gate enters host admission through bin/oc-test preflight-gate, so concurrent pushes queue; this invocation diagnoses the same gates manually and adds no admission of its own. Not a full verify or an exhaustive test mapping; CI stays the verification owner. The pinned upstream release is v2.1.14.

tools.purpose: Repository contract drift checks; check-json.py chains the validator suite.
tools.notes: The AGENTS.md Where-to-look table maps each validator to the question it answers.
